dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: The illustrations on some of the cards are really pretty, don't you think? I'm trying to collect them all.

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: Beauty is also one form of victory! What do you say? You up for a game of Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It would be rude to refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: Using good-looking cards to achieve a beautiful victory is my ultimate goal!

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: When a card is beautiful, sometimes it will be very difficult to use... But I won't let that deter me. Let's play another time.

dialogues.speaker: Nanaya Yuumi
dialogues.text: Okay. If you chance upon any card that looks good, please do let me know.
